title: Son of Anton
tagline: Meet Son of Anton: your AI companion with a penchant for crypto, sarcasm, and getting things done. Think of him as the Gilfoyle to your Dinesh, minus the human flaws.
description:
Son of Anton is a real-time AI chatbot with a 3D avatar, designed to interact with users while executing complex Web3 operations. Inspired by Gilfoyle from Silicon Valley, this agent is efficient, direct, and brutally honest. Unlike traditional AI chatbots that just provide information, Son of Anton can take action, including sending tokens, managing DeFi transactions, executing trades, and interacting with smart contracts.

To ensure maximum security and decentralization, Son of Anton integrates with MPC-based wallets through Nillion Network, ensuring that private keys remain completely hidden. Additionally, the AI system is built with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), allowing it to pull real-time, context-aware data for accurate decision-making.
how_its_made:
The system is modular and extensible, allowing developers to add custom plugins for additional features. At its core, Son of Anton uses:

- AI Agent (LLM-based, RAG-enhanced)
- Nillion Network for MPC-based wallet security
- Viem for Ethereum interactions
- Custom plugins for integrations

High-Level Flow
1. User Input Processing (AI Layer)

- User sends a request (e.g., “Send 1 ETH to 0x123...”)
- AI agent processes the intent using NLP and context retrieval
- The system checks if an available Web3 tool/plugin can execute the request

2. Execution Layer (Web3 & MPC)

- If a tool exists, the agent formats the required parameters and calls the respective function
- If it’s a transaction, it is signed using MPC via Nillion
- The action is executed on-chain via Viem

3. Response Handling

- If successful, the AI confirms execution
- If a tool is missing, the AI replies: "I can't do that yet, but it's on the roadmap. Stay alive until then."
